description: System and deployment architecture: services, data stores, queues, actors and the containers (networks, clusters, boundaries) that hold them. Read this before writing an architecture diagram so kinds are valid first time; unknown kinds are accepted but flagged by lint.

nodeKinds.name: service
nodeKinds.description: A deployable component: API, web app, worker, function.

props.url: Where it runs or its repository

nodeKinds.name: database
nodeKinds.description: A relational or document store.

nodeKinds.name: queue
nodeKinds.description: A message broker, cache, stream or topic.

nodeKinds.name: actor
nodeKinds.description: A person or role that uses the system.

nodeKinds.name: external
nodeKinds.description: A third-party system outside the boundary.

nodeKinds.name: container
nodeKinds.description: A boundary: VPC, cluster, region, trust zone, team. Children reference it via parent.

nodeKinds.name: note
nodeKinds.description: Annotation.

nodeKinds.name: text
nodeKinds.description: Free-standing text with no box.

nodeKinds.name: image
nodeKinds.description: An uploaded image or logo; props.assetId points at the asset.

props.assetId: Asset id of the uploaded image

nodeKinds.name: sticky
nodeKinds.description: A coloured review note; not part of the architecture.

nodeKinds.name: load-balancer
nodeKinds.description: Distributes traffic across several instances of a service.

nodeKinds.name: api-gateway
nodeKinds.description: The single entry point that routes and authenticates API calls.

nodeKinds.name: cache
nodeKinds.description: A fast store for data that is expensive to read from its source.

nodeKinds.name: cdn
nodeKinds.description: A content delivery edge that serves static assets close to users.

nodeKinds.name: firewall
nodeKinds.description: A network boundary that allows or blocks traffic.

nodeKinds.name: object-storage
nodeKinds.description: A bucket of blobs or files, addressed by key.

nodeKinds.name: function
nodeKinds.description: A serverless function run on demand rather than a long-lived service.

nodeKinds.name: router
nodeKinds.description: Forwards traffic between two or more networks.

nodeKinds.name: switch
nodeKinds.description: Connects several devices within one network.

nodeKinds.name: access-point
nodeKinds.description: Bridges wireless clients onto a wired network.

nodeKinds.name: workstation
nodeKinds.description: A user's endpoint device on the network.

nodeKinds.name: modem
nodeKinds.description: Connects a local network to an external line.

nodeKinds.name: hub
nodeKinds.description: A legacy device that repeats traffic to every port.

nodeKinds.name: auto-scaling-group
nodeKinds.description: A set of interchangeable instances that scales with load.

nodeKinds.name: container-image
nodeKinds.description: A packaged, immutable application image.

nodeKinds.name: ci-cd
nodeKinds.description: An automated build, test and deploy pipeline.

nodeKinds.name: vpn
nodeKinds.description: An encrypted tunnel between two networks.

nodeKinds.name: dns
nodeKinds.description: Resolves names to network addresses.

nodeKinds.name: deployment
nodeKinds.description: A controller that keeps a declared number of pods running.

nodeKinds.name: ingress
nodeKinds.description: Routes external traffic into a cluster.

nodeKinds.name: configmap
nodeKinds.description: Configuration kept apart from the container image.

nodeKinds.name: persistent-volume
nodeKinds.description: Storage that outlives the pod that mounted it.

nodeKinds.name: namespace
nodeKinds.description: A partition of a cluster for a team or project.

nodeKinds.name: role
nodeKinds.description: A person's role in an org chart: name and title on two lines in a plain box.

nodeKinds.name: executive
nodeKinds.description: An emphasis role box, for a leadership position; drawn with a double border.

nodeKinds.name: assistant
nodeKinds.description: An assistant attached to a manager on an offset side branch; the tree layout places it beside its manager.

nodeKinds.name: vacancy
nodeKinds.description: A role that is not filled; drawn as a dashed box.

nodeKinds.name: class
nodeKinds.description: A UML class: a box with name, attribute and operation compartments. The label is the name; props.attributes and props.operations are arrays of member strings, one per line, each starting with a visibility glyph (+ public, - private, # protected, ~ package).

props.attributes: Array of attribute strings, e.g. ["- id: UUID"]
props.operations: Array of operation strings, e.g. ["+ save(): void"]
props.stereotype: Optional text shown as <<stereotype>> above the name

nodeKinds.name: interface
nodeKinds.description: A UML interface: the class box with an <<interface>> stereotype line; list its operations in props.operations.

props.operations: Array of operation strings, e.g. ["+ find(id: UUID): User"]

nodeKinds.name: provided-interface
nodeKinds.description: A UML provided interface in lollipop notation (a ball on a stem); connect its stem to the class that implements the interface.

nodeKinds.name: required-interface
nodeKinds.description: A UML required interface in socket notation (a half-circle on a stem); connect its stem to the class that depends on the interface.

nodeKinds.name: entity
nodeKinds.description: A database table (entity-relationship diagram): one box whose label is the table name and whose rows are props.columns, an array of strings, one column per string, each written [PK] [FK] name type [not null | null] - e.g. "PK Id int not null", "FK UserId nvarchar(50) not null", "Email nvarchar(100) null", "PK FK OrderId int not null" (one PK row per key column, so a composite key is several PK rows). Relate two entities with an association edge whose style.arrowStart and style.arrowEnd are crow's-foot ends (one, zeroOrOne, oneAndOnlyOne, many, zeroOrMany, oneOrMany). An edge end attaches to one column's row with the port col:<name> (DSL: edge e_1 association t_order.col:CustomerId -> t_customer.col:Id), drawn from the FK column to the referenced key column.

props.columns: Array of column strings, e.g. ["PK Id int not null", "Email nvarchar(100) null"]

nodeKinds.name: weak-entity
nodeKinds.description: A weak entity: a table that cannot be identified without its owner, drawn as an entity with a double border. Columns are props.columns exactly as for an entity; its key normally has PK FK rows for the owner's key.

props.columns: Array of column strings, e.g. ["PK FK OwnerId int not null", "PK Line int not null"]

edgeKinds.name: flow
edgeKinds.description: A request or call; label with the protocol or operation (HTTPS, gRPC, publish).

edgeKinds.name: data
edgeKinds.description: Data read or written; label with the access pattern (read/write, read-only).

edgeKinds.name: dependency
edgeKinds.description: Build-time or logical dependency with no runtime traffic.

edgeKinds.name: association
edgeKinds.description: A non-directional link, typically note to component.

edgeKinds.name: dotted-report
edgeKinds.description: A dotted-line report: a secondary or informal reporting relationship, drawn dashed.
